summary: # Common C4 Model Mistakes to Avoid This guide documents frequent anti-patterns and errors when creating C4 architecture diagrams, with examples of what to do instead. ## Abstraction Level Mistakes ### 1. Confusing Containers and Components **The Problem:** Containers are **deployable units** (applications, services, databases). Components are **non-deployable elements inside a container** (modules, classes, packages). **Wrong - Java class shown as container:** ```mermaid C4Container title WRONG: Class as Container
